notes: Share-page text in which a user turn holds a closed code block that quotes two speaker lines of an older conversation.

Apple has no fence rule in the share-page parser and removes the text on a speaker line: the two quoted lines become turns of their own, and what is left of the conversation is two fence lines. Until 2026-11-20 the web rule also began a turn at every line that begins with a speaker label. Now such a line is text when it stands inside a closed fenced block and the fences of the paste pair up: the block stays whole in the user turn, and the label words are stored with it.
